environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) with TCP passthrough on port 443. TLS termination occurs at the application via nginx reverse proxy. No application-layer inspection is performed by the NLB. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The application serves an internal HR directory but is internet-facing for remote employees.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB (TCP mode, no content inspection)
